summary: Inline nested loops now have unique history subjects based on their owning step paths, so same-named loops no longer share round results or feedback

replay.detail: Existing claims are not rewritten. New nested-loop revisions derive distinct loop history subjects.

schema.detail: No claim kind, field or subject pattern changes.

compatibility.detail: Publication hashes change for missions containing inline nested loops on the next source apply or sync. Top-level loop hashes and subjects are unchanged. Runs in progress keep their pinned revision and existing history subjects, including any existing collisions, unless a new revision is explicitly adopted.

manual.detail: No migration required; newly published revisions use the corrected paths.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; runs retain their pinned revision bodies.
